results.title: Candace Parker, Aliyah Boston has interesting Year 4 debate
results.description: League icon Candace Parker and Indiana Fever star Aliyah Boston sparked a lively basketball debate while reflecting on their respective careers, with the conversation centering on whether Boston in her fourth WNBA season could defeat Parker during one of the early stages of her legendary career.
